titulo: Vibe Coder in Residence — Full Time
descripcion_html:
You're a builder who can't stop shipping. Specifically:

  • Experience launching mobile apps — this is a hard requirement. You've shipped to the App Store or Google Play, not just localhost.
  • Fluent in the new stack. AI agents, vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, v0, Replit, etc.), and whatever ships next week.
  • Receipts. You build in public and can prove it — GitHub, live projects, launch threads, demo videos.
  • Fast shipper. You're comfortable going from idea to live product in a day and iterating in production.
  • Low-ego, high-output. You treat "impossible" as a dare.

Zagged is a creator marketing and content distribution agency that has generated over 1 billion views for DTC brands across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook. Distribution is our core business — which means anything you build gets marketing firepower most indie developers can only dream of.

You'll be the first Vibe Coder in Residence on our new internal product lab, working alongside a team of operators who have all built businesses before. The model is simple: you ship prototypes, micro-apps, and experiments daily, and we point our distribution machine at whatever works. You imagine it, you ship it, we make it go everywhere. No red tape, no marketing responsibilities — just building.

The Vibe Coder in Residence ("VCR") is part builder, part mad scientist, part hype machine. You use AI tools to turn "wouldn't it be cool if..." into something live — same day. No red tape, no approval chains.

  • Ship daily. Prototypes, micro-apps, and experiments. If it's fun and useful, it goes live.
  • Build in public. Demos, threads, and behind-the-scenes content that puts Zagged everywhere.
  • Remix what works. Take a win, loop it, and make it better across growth, content, and product.
  • Never touch marketing. You focus entirely on building — distribution is our core business, and we aim it at your projects.

Success is measured in shipped projects, not meetings attended.

None of these are required, but they'll make us pay attention:

  • Growth or consumer product instincts — you know what makes something shareable before you build it.
  • Familiarity with social/creator platforms — TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or short-form content tools.
  • Your own audience or distribution channel — a following on X, a newsletter, a YouTube channel, anything.
  • Design taste — your projects look good, not just work.
  • Strong opinions about fonts. Yes, really. There's a question about this in the application.
  • Fully remote team setup, enabling flexible work from anywhere.
  • Fast-paced startup environment where shipping and learning are prioritized.
  • Collaborative engineering culture with active peer review and shared ownership of outcomes.
If you’re a mid-level engineer who enjoys building both app and web features and wants to grow in a remote, high-velocity team, we’d love to hear from you.
